description: Chapters of OpenStax textbooks, used as a fixed retrieval corpus. The PDFs are downloaded by fetch_corpus.py into evals/.cache/ and are not committed.
license_note: All three books state on their copyright page: 'licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution Non-Commercial ShareAlike 4.0 International License (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)'. This is non-commercial use only. The text is never committed to this repository.

openstax-intro-python.title: Introduction to Python Programming
openstax-intro-python.authors: Udayan Das, Aubrey Lawson, Chris Mayfield, Narges Norouzi

openstax-biology-2e.title: Biology 2e
openstax-biology-2e.authors: Mary Ann Clark, Matthew Douglas, Jung Choi

openstax-psychology-2e.title: Psychology 2e
openstax-psychology-2e.authors: Rose M. Spielman, William J. Jenkins, Marilyn D. Lovett

documents.subject: computer science
documents.note: PDF page numbers of the source book. End-of-chapter summaries, quizzes and answer keys are left out.

documents.subject: science
documents.note: Stops before Key Terms, so summaries and review questions are left out.

documents.subject: social science
documents.note: Stops before Key Terms in each chapter, so summaries and review questions are left out.

expected_structure_note: Chunk count and a hash of every chunk's section path, as produced by app/services/document_processor/chunker.py on the commit that recorded the baseline. run_eval.py warns when they differ, because topics.jsonl chunk_range specs depend on them.
